notes.title: Hacky Demo Leaving Steam Soon
notes.content:
We want to inform you that the current demo of Hacky will be removed from Steam at the end of December 2024. This decision comes after careful consideration of our game's evolution and player feedback.

Since the initial release, Hacky has undergone significant improvements and transformations. The current demo no longer represents the enhanced experience of the full version. The backend of the game has been extensively reworked, making it challenging to maintain the demo alongside the main game.

If you're interested in experiencing the latest version of Hacky, we encourage you to explore the full game, which reflects our commitment to continuous improvement based on community feedback.
Thank you for your understanding and ongoing support.

notes.title: UI Scaling Hotfix: Resolving Screen Resolution and Button Placement Issues
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed critical UI scaling bug causing buttons and interface elements to extend beyond screen boundaries
[*] Restored proper UI visibility and accessibility across different screen resolutions
[*] Ensured settings menu remains fully navigable and adjustable
[/list]

We strongly recommend this update for anyone who experienced problems with UI scaling. If you're still having issues after the update, please reach out and let us know. We appreciate all of your feedback and apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced!

notes.title: UI Scale Feature Added
notes.content:
We've added a UI Scale option to the game settings, which allows players to adjust the overall user interface size if they find the default font too small. Players can now customize their interface to suit their preferences.

When changing the UI Scale to "Large" or "Extra Large," please be aware that there's a slight possibility of some UI elements overlapping in certain localizations. Don't worry, though – you can modify the UI Scale at any time directly in the game settings without needing to restart the game.
In cases where the larger UI size might cause network nodes to go off-screen. You can easily pan the camera by clicking and dragging your mouse to view the names of those nodes.

We appreciate all the feedback that helped us implement this feature. Thank you for helping us improve the game's accessibility and user experience.

notes.title: 'jump' command adjustment and minor writing improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 'Jump' command now allows bypassing OTP by using pre-deployed backdoors, re-open all opened nodes inside the device (yea, we turn a bug into a feature!)
[*] Fixed logging issues for Firewall-protected devices
[*] Corrected override log messages
[*] Improved Sleeper Agent OS description
[/list]

Thank you again for all of your feedback :D

notes.title: Game Balance Update
notes.content:
[h2]Crypto Miner OS Rework[/h2]
The Bitcoin-earning mechanism has been refined. Instead of gaining 1 Bitcoin per move, players now earn double Bitcoin from Bitcoin files. However, this comes with increased risk: getting these files will now trigger 1.5x the System Alert. This change encourages more strategic file picking, making suppression files more valuable than ever. Players can get rich faster, but must be more cautious.

[h2]Middle Man OS Enhancements[/h2]
The Middle Man OS now provides gateway directions across the network. Unlike the 'scan' side command, Middle Man passive ability is always active and doesn't incur any System Alert cost. The ability to restore System Alert when visiting the home node remains unchanged.

[h2]Suppression Command Balancing[/h2]
The 'suppress' side command has been adjusted to prevent potential exploit strategies. While the initial execution cost remains 10 Bitcoins, the cost will now incrementally increase with each use within the same network. Connecting through a gateway will reset the cost to its original value.

[h2]Cloak Command Modification[/h2]
The 'cloak' command no longer prevents System Alerts triggered by self-re-execution or other side commands, including the 'sweep' command from Hacky OS Beta.

[h2]Add Requested Command Alias[/h2]
In response to player feedback, we've added and corrected the 'cd ..' command (with a space) as alternative command to 'back', which was previously mistakenly implemented as 'cd..' (without a space).

These changes aim to create a more balanced and strategic gameplay and more pleasure experience. Thank you for all of your feedback. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Add "cd.." as alternative command to "back"
notes.content: You can now use "cd.." as an alternative command to "back" when moving one node closer to home. This new alias mimics real-world command-line conventions, adding a touch of familiarity to the game's navigation. This was a player's request, and it sounds fun, so why not? :D

notes.title: Add Dvorak and Colemak Support
notes.content:
We've added support for Dvorak and Colemak keyboard layouts due to how rotation mini game work. You can now switch between these alternate keyboard layouts at any time through the game settings. 

Additionally, we've fixed an issue where typing certain symbols in the console would cause the game to soft lock.

Thank you for all of your feedback!

notes.title: Balance Update: "Suppress" Side Command Adjustment
notes.content: We've made changes to the "suppress" side command since it was proving too powerful in gameplay. The command now reduces your System Alert level by half rather than completely removing it, though it still costs 10 Bitcoins to use. We've also fixed the incorrect descriptions and log messages that were appearing across all language versions.

notes.title: Improve rotation minigame
notes.content:
We've made a few adjustments based on player feedback:

First, we've fixed a bug where some of the generated rotations were unwinnable. This should no longer be an issue.

We've also simplified the rotation minigame at the earlier difficulty levels to make it less confusing for new players. However, the rotation challenge will ramp up at the higher difficulty settings to provide a greater test of your skills.

Finally, we want to express our sincere gratitude for all the feedback we've received from the community. Your input is invaluable as we continue to improve and refine the game. Please keep the feedback coming - it really does make a difference!

We hope you enjoy this latest update. Happy hacking!

notes.title: Typing with pleasure update
notes.content:
INITIATING SYSTEM UPDATE v1.0.0.2
EXECUTING PROTOCOL: ENHANCEMENT

ATTENTION OPERATIVES:

We've intercepted vital intel from our network of shadow agents and systematically eliminated multiple security vulnerabilities. Your field reports have been instrumental in optimizing our systems. The following upgrades have been deployed to strengthen our digital arsenal.

[h3]Enhanced Node Name Generation[/h3]
- Implemented real-world word generation for node names, making commands more intuitive to type
- Added toggle option in settings to switch between new and classic generation methods
- Optimized classic random letter generation to reduce uncomfortable key combinations (q, a, x, w, z)
- Changes take effect on new levels after updating settings

[h3]Customizable Hack Speed[/h3]
- Introduced hack speed multiplier in settings
- Perfect for players who enjoy rapid-fire keyboard input
Note: Must be configured before starting a new game session

[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
- CHIP DATA now saves to wallet on manual disconnection
- Added comprehensive tutorial for the rotation mini-game (skipable)
- Enhanced overall game accessibility for international players

[h3]Bugs Fixed[/h3]
- Fixed an issue on EXPLORERIT able to jump to blank node.
- Fixed an issue on name generation interfered with user's command-line.
